neighbours.label: ' by' when it introduces how or when something is done ('by perturbing them', 'by adding flour', 'by Friday'), not the agent of a passive ('written by a nurse'), firing on ' by'.
fire: You can save energy by switching off the lights.
She learned Spanish by watching films.
Please send the forms by Monday.
The team cut costs by sharing offices.
He fixed the leak by tightening the valve.
The report must be ready by noon.
We crossed the river by building a raft.
Students improve by practising every day.
quiet: The lights were switched off by the caretaker.
The film was watched by millions in Spain.
The forms were signed by the manager.
The offices are shared by two teams.
The leak was fixed by a plumber.
The report was written by an intern.
The raft was built by the scouts.
The song was practised by the choir.

short: ' by' of means or deadline, not passive agent
notes: Broad pole (2.4% of tokens above 0.1). Card: ' by' x13, ' consider' x3, ' of' x3 (probing the roles of proteins,⟦ by⟧ perturbing them); output promotes gerunds ' creating', ' adding', ' finding'. Exploratory probe: 'by perturbing them' 0.47, 'by adding flour' 0.39, 'by Friday' 0.57; 'written by a nurse' 0.08.
